thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert: node-pool-7 experienced 3x container restarts in 5m. Symptoms: CUDA driver errors + OOMs on paged-attn allocator. Rolling errors started ~6943209950. Auto-silent-fallback engaged for some requests.
eric_oncall: I'm on it. Confirming which customers routed to pool-7?
jon_runtime: pool-7 serves hosted models: rdx-7b-qa and rdx-13b-batched. We saw paged KV fragmentation creeping up. Metrics: kv_page_frag_ratio ~0.74 and slow allocation drain.
maya_sre: seeing CUDA: "CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS" in logs around the restarts. Also container OOM on worker-2 before crash.
lin_custsuccess: any customer impact? A few support tickets reporting 504s and increased gen latency ~2.5x in europe-west-2. Affected orgs: org-phi, org-zen (low volume but real-time pipelines).
eric_oncall: ok. Short checklist: (1) isolate node, (2) reduce traffic -> route to fallback pool, (3) attempt live mitigation (evict KV pages / force compact), (4) prepare rolling restart if it persists.
jon_runtime: mitigation steps I can try now: reduce KV cache to 40% on pool-7, force immediate slab compaction, and enable 'paged-attn-strict-evict' which trades a bit of perf for stability. Commands: ```rdctl cluster set-config --pool pool-7 --kv-cache-percent 40 && rdctl runtime evict --pool pool-7 --mode aggressive```
maya_sre: I'll cordon the node from k8s side to avoid new pods landing while we triage: ```kubectl cordon node/node-7-az2``` then scale down non-critical replicas. Also recommend bumping container restart backoff to avoid thundering restarts.
deploy-bot: Routing rule change applied: 60% traffic diverted off pool-7 to pool-3 (fallback), 40% to pool-9 canary.
eric_oncall: jon, proceed with KV reduction and compaction now. Keep me posted on logs. Lin, please track customer-facing comms and see if we should raise to a proactive status page message.
jon_runtime: running compaction now. Patch log: "allocator: starting slab compact pass id=4632". Monitoring mem delta.
jon_runtime: compaction ran. Observed immediate drop in resident memory on worker-2 from 42GB -> 28GB, KV fragmentation ratio fell to 0.52. No more OOMs in last 30s.
maya_sre: CUDA errors have stopped for now but I want a full node restart once traffic is fully shifted. Also capturing coredump and nvml logs to s3://incidents/6943210000/ for postmortem.
lin_custsuccess: notifying org-phi and org-zen with short note: "We observed increased latency and transient errors between T-10m and T0. Mitigations applied, minimal impact to most flows. We're monitoring and will update."
eric_oncall: good. Action items: - Jon: follow up with permanent mitigation (kv eviction tuning + allocator safety checks) and open PR with telemetry to detect slow-frag drift. - Maya: plan controlled node restart and retention of diagnostics. - Lin: post brief on status page if errors spike again. I will create a sev2 ticket and assign.
eric_oncall: tagging for follow-up: @jon_runtime, @maya_sre, @lin_custsuccess. Marking this thread as live-handoff. :white_check_mark:
